appearance.subtle: Old cuts on their hands have healed into raised white cord.
appearance.obvious: Thick ropes of scar tissue cross their forearms and throat, every one of them raised and pale.
appearance.extreme: They are armoured in their own scar tissue, overlapping ridges of it from jaw to knuckle. Nothing on them has healed flat.

description: You heal fast, and you heal wrong. Every wound closes into thick ropey tissue that never fades, so you are a written record of everything that has happened to you.
drawbacks: The scarring accumulates and never fades
name: Regenerative Scarring
